runtime_rule.inactive_transaction: must not enter resident-Island transaction context
runtime_rule.active_transaction_before_ready: must fail closed without entering resident-Island transaction context
runtime_rule.active_transaction_after_ready: may enter the single transaction-context seam
runtime_rule.publication: rtov_island_state becomes READY only after copy and destination CRC succeed

permanent_gates.guard_shape: the sole permitted Island edge is dominated by inactive-transaction and Island-READY checks

wrong target, wrong length, nonzero fill, wrong callee, incomplete address pair and extra Island reference are rejected
